en: You do not seem to grasp what I mean. Then let me say it once more...

jp: {voice:00EB09}息づかいすら腹立たしいので、{n}私の前から消えてくださいまし。
en: Your very breathing vexes me, so kindly vanish from my sight.

jp: {voice:00EC09}ん、なななななな！{n}ちょ、ちょっとカワユイからって{n}調子コキやがって②
en: Wh-wh-wh-what! Just 'cause you're kinda cute, you're gettin' full of yourself!

jp: {voice:00ED09}なに、あのゴシック女？{n}連中にケンカふっかけてるけど…
en: What's with that Gothic girl? She's picking a fight with them...

jp: {voice:00EE09}うーん、正直意味がわからんな。{n}しかし奴らを最初に怒らせたのは{n}あたし達だからね……
en: Hmm, honestly, I don't get it. But we're the ones who got them mad in the first place...

jp: {voice:00EF09}助けるべきかもね、ここは。
en: Maybe we should help her out here.

jp: {voice:00F009}まあ、なんと恐ろしいお顔。{n}どうして怒っているのかしら？
en: My, what a frightful face. Why ever are you angry?

jp: {voice:00F109}おいおいおーい！{n}どこまで俺達の純情を弄べば{n}気が済むんだ③
en: Hey, hey, hey! How much are you gonna toy with our innocent hearts?!

jp: {voice:00F209}泣いて許しを乞う事になるぜ！
en: We'll have you cryin' and beggin' forgiveness!

jp: {voice:00F309}もういい…、女の子の気持ちは{n}俺には理解できないから、諦める！
en: That's it... I can't understand how girls feel, so I give up!

jp: {voice:00F409}やっぱ女との恋慕よりも{n}男同士の友情っすね！
en: Friendship between men beats chasing girls after all, man!

jp: {voice:00F509}…お前、いいこと言うな！{n}よし、一杯やりに行くか③
en: ...You said a good thing there! All right, let's go have a drink?!

jp: {voice:00F609}ええっ、行くっすよ②{n}酔った勢いで岩肌にラクガキとか{n}するっすよ②
en: Yeah, let's go, man! We'll get drunk and scribble on the cliffs, man!

jp: {voice:00F709}ようやく諦めたわね。{n}まったくタフな連中だよ。
en: They finally gave up. What a tough bunch, honestly.

jp: {voice:00F809}親切な皆様、{n}お助け頂き感謝申し上げますわ。
en: Kind people, I offer you my thanks for coming to my aid.

jp: {voice:00F909}いや、元はと言えば、あたし達が{n}奴らを焚きつけたんだ。
en: No, it was us who stirred them up in the first place.

jp: {voice:00FA09}こっちの方こそ、{n}巻き込んでしまって悪かったな。
en: We're the ones who should apologize for dragging you into it.

jp: {voice:00FB09}私はイータ。{n}吟遊詩人のイータと申します。
en: I am Eater. Eater the bard, at your service.

jp: {voice:00FC09}私はシスキア。{n}ここにいるのはみんな{n}グラムブレイズの団員だよ。
en: I'm Siskier. Everyone here's part of Gram Blaze.

jp: {voice:00FD09}まあ…！　あなた方が噂の？{n}あの勇壮な戦いぶり…{n}なるほど、合点がいきました。
en: My...! You are the ones they speak of? That gallant way of fighting... I see, it all makes sense.

jp: {voice:00FE09}お姉ちゃんもすごく強かったよ！{n}歌声で敵を倒すなんて{n}オっシャレー。
en: You were really strong too, Big Sis! Beating enemies with your singing, that's so stylish.

jp: {voice:00FF09}…見たところ女性ばかりですが、{n}殿方はいらっしゃらないのですか？
en: ...I see only women here. Are there no gentlemen with you?

jp: {voice:00000A}今日は非番でここにはいません。
en: They are off duty today and not here.

jp: {voice:00010A}あらあらあら…、{n}その非番の殿方とは、強く素敵で{n}そしてイケてる殿方なのですか？
en: Oh my, my, my... These off-duty gentlemen, are they strong, splendid and handsome gentlemen?

jp: {voice:00020A}素敵って、どうかわかんないけど{n}まぁ、強い連中が揃ってるよ。
en: I don't know about splendid, but, well, they're a strong bunch.

jp: {voice:00030A}……、あら、失礼。{n}一度、お会いしたいですわね。{n}その殿方達を、ご紹介頂けますか？
en: ......Oh, excuse me. I would so like to meet them. Might you introduce me to those gentlemen?

jp: {voice:00040A}えっ③　なんで？
en: Huh?! Why?

jp: {voice:00050A}私は吟遊詩人。{n}歌のネタを探して旅しております。
en: I am a bard. I travel in search of material for my songs.

jp: {voice:00060A}素敵な殿方を毎夜……、あら失礼。{n}そうではなく、グラムブレイズを{n}是非に歌にしたいと存じます。
en: Splendid gentlemen, every night... Oh, excuse me. Rather, I do wish to put Gram Blaze in song.

jp: {voice:00070A}そろそろ日が暮れてきたな。{n}立ち話もなんだし、中で待つか？
en: The sun's about to set. Why stand around talking? Want to wait inside?

jp: {voice:00080A}お、気が利くねぇ、アンタ{n}じゃあ待たせてもらおうか。{n}あー、カッタリィ、この服…
en: Oh, you're on the ball there. Guess I'll wait, then. Ugh, what a drag, these clothes...

jp: {voice:00090A}そうそう、メシ無い、メシ？{n}腹へってんだよな、オレ。{n}ハラヘリって感じ？　だろ？
en: Oh yeah, got any grub? Grub? I'm starving. Totally starving, y'know? Right?

jp: {voice:000A0A}アンタ誰？
en: Who are you?

jp: {voice:000B0A}なに言ってんだよバーカ。{n}さっき名乗ったろ、イータだよ。
en: The hell are you on about, stupid. I told you a sec ago, I'm Eater.

jp: {voice:000C0A}もしや、二重人格では？
en: Might this be a split personality?

jp: {voice:000D0A}あ、悪い悪い、言うの忘れたわ。{n}オレ、夜になると男になんだよね。{n}よ・ろ・し・く、ってね。
en: Oh, my bad, forgot to say. I turn into a guy at night. Pleased to meet ya, okay?

jp: {voice:000E0A}は？
en: What?

jp: {voice:000F0A}男！　夜になると男になるの。{n}ＯＫ？　理解した？{n}あーしかしウゼェ、この服ウゼェ…
en: A guy! I turn into a guy at night. Okay? Got it? Man, these clothes are a pain in the ass...

jp: {voice:00100A}また、変なの来ちゃったよ……
en: Another weirdo's turned up...

jp: あーら、こんなに傷を負って{n}しまいましたわ。
en: Oh dear, I have taken such wounds.

jp: …な、何をなさいますの！{n}汚らわしい、{n}離してくださいませ！
en: ...Wh-what are you doing! You filthy thing, unhand me!
